inputs.buildOutcome: Create a complete beginner EC2 Follow Along for an AWS learner starting with no existing infrastructure. Walk the learner through creating a dedicated training IAM user and the permissions required for this lab, signing in as that user, configuring and verifying AWS CLI access, creating a VPC, public subnet, internet gateway, route table and tightly scoped security group, launching an Amazon Linux 2023 EC2 instance, selecting the instance type, storage, network, subnet, security group and IAM role, connecting safely with AWS Systems Manager Session Manager, installing and starting a simple Apache web server, opening the website in a browser, examining the instance ID, public and private IP addresses, instance state, availability zone, tags, security group and EBS volume, stopping and starting the instance to observe what changes, creating and verifying an EBS snapshot, and safely deleting only the resources created by the lab. Include complete separate AWS Management Console and AWS CLI routes. Assume the learner has never used EC2 and explain every important click, menu, field, value, command, placeholder, permission, expected result, verification and cleanup action. Explain why each major setting matters for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate SAA-C03 exam. Use fixed harmless training resource names and official AWS documentation only.
